## About this blog

This is a collection of notes on **modern data science skills** with a focus on:

- Real-world data and observational studies
- Clinical trials methodology
- Causal inference
- R programming

I created this space so I can find **notes with code and rendered results** easily. The target audience is future-me — but if it helps you too, I'd be happy!

## About me

I work at the intersection of statistics, epidemiology, and software development in healthcare and pharma.

If you spot errors or have suggestions, feel free to reach out!
